test_id: background path selection and rendering 'background authored path: templated l…'

findings.rationale: The NLSpec explicitly requires templated legacy `head.templates.body.style.background` objects to transform `{{$jason.url}}` into the exact dynamic URL, emit it through `src`, and omit `srcdoc` (section 3.5 and DoD 6.8). It also defines body-mode propagation and ordinary non-text field transformation. Therefore the repeated failure reveals an implementation defect, not missing or ambiguous specification.
